verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no official Pipedrive CLI for operating the CRM from a terminal or agent workflow. What it does document is adjacent: an MCP server (a different story), a NodeJS API client and an OpenAPI spec (developer building blocks), and create-pipedrive-app, which scaffolds a new app rather than providing a CLI for working with Pipedrive data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
